description: Create and manage Form.io forms, resources, actions, roles, and projects from your AI agent.
name: io.form/formio-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Full URL of the Form.io project to target (e.g. https://api.form.io/my-project, or https://your-host/project-name for self-hosted).
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_PROJECT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Form.io deployment — the parent of FORMIO_PROJECT_URL (default: https://api.form.io). Set this when self-hosting or using Form.io Enterprise.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Form.io project API key. Optional — when omitted the server uses a browser-based portal login flow to obtain a JWT.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: URL of a custom login form used by the browser-based portal login flow. Defaults to the deployment's portal login form.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification. For local development against self-signed certificates only — never enable in production.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_INSECURE_TLS
